added.summary: og cook builds an og-shape program as a model, deterministically: the program file itself, or a `type model` text naming it (`program "chair.shape.json"`) with `params { height 1100 }` over the program's "params" and `material "<name>" { color map metalness roughness opacity emissive }` blocks over its materials. A program declares "params": {"height": 900} and gives any operation's field as "$height". A field may also be an expression over the params and numbers ("($width - 40) / 2": + - * / and parentheses), evaluated in f64 at cook time; an undeclared name, a stray character or a division by zero is an error naming the expression.
